//: ROOT-LEVEL Vercel config, and it exists because of a specific 404.
This repo is a monorepo: `app/` (the Vite SPA) and `contracts/` (Foundry). Vercel builds
from the repository root unless told otherwise, and the root has no index.html - so the
first deploy returned 404 NOT_FOUND on every path including `/`. Nothing was broken in the
app; Vercel was looking at the wrong directory.
Setting Root Directory to `app` in the dashboard fixes it too, but that is a click a human
has to remember on every new project and preview environment. This file makes the correct
layout a property of the repo instead, so a fresh import works with no dashboard state.
Paths below are relative to the REPO ROOT, which is why they all start with `app/`.
buildCommand: cd app && bun install && bun run build
//rewrites: The negative lookahead is load-bearing. An SPA needs every unknown path to fall through to
index.html, but the naive `/(.*)` rule swallows /api/* as well - the upload endpoint would
return the HTML shell and fail with a JSON parse error pointing nowhere near the cause.
